info.description: 23 recovered native Refit operations plus one static browser authorization helper. Live observations are labeled per request; unobserved operations remain static contracts. All patron IDs, tokens and session variables are empty. No global authentication, scripts, automatic token extraction or mutation tests are installed. Declared route/header quirks are preserved. Import this collection and fill the variables needed by your selected request.

request.description: Static helper, not captured live. Evidence: app.config; Spydus.Helpers.AuthConstants; OAuthUriBuilderExtensions; app-string-evidence.json method token 0x06000adf. Route /openid/authorize, response_type=code, client_id=spydusmobile, redirect_uri=spyduslibrary://auth. Base scope is openid profile mobile; the app appends libid_<library GUID> and lang_<languageIdentifier>. Fill scope from the selected library before authorizing; do not guess empty-language suffix behavior. The app conditionally sets prompt=login for forced interaction. Browser authorization redirects to the app callback. No PKCE behavior is asserted by this helper.
